```{r setup, include = FALSE}
PROJ <- path.expand("~/Downloads/Data-Mining-Final-Project-main") 
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJ)
setwd(PROJ)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%", dpi = 300)
source(file.path(PROJ, "data_prep.R"))   # RANDOM_SEED, FEATURES, get_splits()
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

TAB_DIR  <- file.path("outputs", "tables")
FIG_DIR  <- "figures"
FEAT_DIR <- file.path("results", "top_features")
for (d in c(TAB_DIR, FIG_DIR, FEAT_DIR)) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

TARGET_RECALL <- 0.95   # recall goal used to pick a lower, recall-focused threshold

# One color per model, used in every figure
MODEL_COLS <- c("Logistic (baseline)" = "#7f7f7f", "Ridge" = "#1f78b4", "Lasso" = "#e66101")

theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

# Save every figure as both vector PDF and 300-dpi PNG in figures/
save_fig <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = width, height = height)
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = width, height = height,
         dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  p
}
```

# Data

We use the shared split from `data_prep.R` (stratified 80/20, seed `r RANDOM_SEED`, features
standardized with training-set means and SDs).

```{r data}
sp <- get_splits(scale = TRUE)
x_train <- as.matrix(sp$X_train); y_train <- sp$y_train
x_test  <- as.matrix(sp$X_test);  y_test  <- sp$y_test

kable(data.frame(set = c("Train", "Test"),
                 n = c(length(y_train), length(y_test)),
                 malignant = c(sum(y_train), sum(y_test)),
                 pct_malignant = round(100 * c(mean(y_train), mean(y_test)), 1)),
      col.names = c("Set", "n", "Malignant", "% malignant"),
      caption = "Class balance after the stratified split")
```

# Baseline: unpenalized logistic regression

```{r baseline}
base_fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(diagnosis ~ ., data = sp$train_df, family = binomial))
s <- summary(abs(coef(base_fit)[-1]))
kable(t(round(unclass(s), 1)), caption = "Absolute coefficients of the unpenalized logistic regression")
```

The unpenalized fit does not converge (R warns that the algorithm did not converge and that fitted
probabilities are numerically 0 or 1), and its coefficients are inflated into the hundreds. With 30
highly correlated predictors and nearly separable classes, the maximum-likelihood estimates are unstable.
This motivates ridge and lasso.

# Ridge and lasso with cross-validation

Both models use the same stratified 10-fold assignment, so their CV errors are directly comparable.
We use `lambda.1se`, the largest penalty within one standard error of the minimum CV deviance, which
gives a simpler model with essentially the same predictive performance.

```{r cv-fits}
set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)
foldid <- integer(length(y_train))
for (cls in c(0, 1)) {
  idx <- which(y_train == cls)
  foldid[idx] <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(idx)))
}

# Ridge: the default lambda grid stops before the CV minimum, so search a wider range
ridge_grid <- exp(seq(log(100), log(1e-4), length.out = 120))
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 0, lambda = ridge_grid,
                      foldid = foldid, type.measure = "deviance", keep = TRUE)
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 1,
                      foldid = foldid, type.measure = "deviance", keep = TRUE)

coef_tbl <- data.frame(
  feature = FEATURES,
  ridge   = as.vector(coef(cv_ridge, s = "lambda.1se"))[-1],
  lasso   = as.vector(coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.1se"))[-1],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(coef(cv_ridge))[-1], FEATURES))
lasso_sel <- coef_tbl[coef_tbl$lasso != 0, c("feature", "lasso")]
lasso_sel <- lasso_sel[order(-abs(lasso_sel$lasso)), ]

kable(data.frame(model = c("Ridge", "Lasso"),
                 lambda_min = signif(c(cv_ridge$lambda.min, cv_lasso$lambda.min), 3),
                 lambda_1se = signif(c(cv_ridge$lambda.1se, cv_lasso$lambda.1se), 3),
                 nonzero = c(sum(coef_tbl$ridge != 0), sum(coef_tbl$lasso != 0))),
      col.names = c("Model", "lambda.min", "lambda.1se", "Nonzero coefficients at lambda.1se"),
      caption = "Penalty strength chosen by 10-fold CV")
```

```{r fig-cv-curves, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
cv_df <- function(cv, name) {
  data.frame(model = name, loglam = log(cv$lambda), cvm = cv$cvm, lo = cv$cvlo, hi = cv$cvup)
}
cv_all <- rbind(cv_df(cv_ridge, "Ridge"), cv_df(cv_lasso, "Lasso"))
cv_all$model <- factor(cv_all$model, levels = c("Ridge", "Lasso"))

vlines <- data.frame(
  model = factor(rep(c("Ridge", "Lasso"), each = 2), levels = c("Ridge", "Lasso")),
  choice = rep(c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se (used)"), 2),
  x = log(c(cv_ridge$lambda.min, cv_ridge$lambda.1se, cv_lasso$lambda.min, cv_lasso$lambda.1se))
)

p_cv <- ggplot(cv_all, aes(loglam, cvm)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = model), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = model), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(data = vlines, aes(xintercept = x, linetype = choice), color = "grey25") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("lambda.min" = "dotted", "lambda.1se (used)" = "dashed"),
                        name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "10-fold cross-validation error",
       x = expression(log(lambda) ~ "(larger = stronger penalty)"),
       y = "Binomial deviance") +
  theme_report
save_fig(p_cv, "cv_curves", 9, 4)
```

```{r fig-lasso-paths, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
fit <- cv_lasso$glmnet.fit
B <- as.matrix(fit$beta)
path_df <- data.frame(feature = rep(rownames(B), ncol(B)),
                      lambda  = rep(fit$lambda, each = nrow(B)),
                      coef    = as.vector(B), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Show the path from the null model down to just past lambda.min, where coefficients stay interpretable
path_df <- path_df[path_df$lambda >= cv_lasso$lambda.min / exp(1), ]

top6 <- head(lasso_sel$feature, 6)
path_df$highlight <- ifelse(path_df$feature %in% top6, path_df$feature, "Other")
path_df$highlight <- factor(path_df$highlight, levels = c(top6, "Other"))

p_path <- ggplot(path_df, aes(log(lambda), coef, group = feature)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_line(data = subset(path_df, highlight == "Other"), color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = subset(path_df, highlight != "Other"), aes(color = highlight), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(cv_lasso$lambda.1se), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  annotate("text", x = log(cv_lasso$lambda.1se), y = Inf, label = "lambda.1se",
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey25") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Lasso coefficient paths",
       x = expression(log(lambda) ~ "(larger = stronger penalty)"),
       y = "Standardized coefficient") +
  theme_report + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
save_fig(p_path, "lasso_paths", 8, 5)
```

# Choosing a recall-focused threshold

Missing a cancer is worse than a false alarm, so besides the default 0.5 cutoff we choose a lower
threshold using **out-of-fold CV predictions on the training set only** (the test set is not used).
The threshold is the largest cutoff whose out-of-fold recall is at least `r TARGET_RECALL`.

```{r thresholds}
oof_prob <- function(cv) {
  p <- cv$fit.preval[, which(cv$lambda == cv$lambda.1se)]
  if (any(p < 0 | p > 1)) p <- plogis(p)   # guard in case predictions are on the link scale
  p
}
pick_threshold <- function(p, y, target = TARGET_RECALL) {
  grid <- seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.01)
  rec  <- sapply(grid, function(t) sum(p >= t & y == 1) / sum(y == 1))
  ok   <- grid[rec >= target]
  if (length(ok)) max(ok) else min(grid)
}
oof <- list(Ridge = oof_prob(cv_ridge), Lasso = oof_prob(cv_lasso))
thr_ridge <- pick_threshold(oof$Ridge, y_train)
thr_lasso <- pick_threshold(oof$Lasso, y_train)
kable(data.frame(Model = c("Ridge", "Lasso"), Threshold = c(thr_ridge, thr_lasso)),
      caption = "Recall-focused thresholds chosen from out-of-fold training predictions")
```

```{r fig-threshold, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
grid <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)
thr_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(oof), function(m) {
  p <- oof[[m]]
  rbind(
    data.frame(model = m, threshold = grid, metric = "Recall",
               value = sapply(grid, function(t) sum(p >= t & y_train == 1) / sum(y_train == 1))),
    data.frame(model = m, threshold = grid, metric = "Precision",
               value = sapply(grid, function(t) {
                 k <- sum(p >= t); if (k == 0) NA else sum(p >= t & y_train == 1) / k }))
  )
}))
thr_df$model <- factor(thr_df$model, levels = c("Ridge", "Lasso"))
chosen <- data.frame(model = factor(c("Ridge", "Lasso"), levels = c("Ridge", "Lasso")),
                     thr = c(thr_ridge, thr_lasso))

p_thr <- ggplot(thr_df, aes(threshold, value, color = metric)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = TARGET_RECALL, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(data = chosen, aes(xintercept = thr), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25") +
  geom_text(data = chosen, aes(x = thr, y = 0.62, label = paste("chosen =", thr)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, size = 3.5, color = "grey25") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Recall = "#b2182b", Precision = "#2166ac"), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.6, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Choosing the classification threshold (training data, out-of-fold)",
       x = "Probability threshold for predicting malignant", y = NULL) +
  theme_report
save_fig(p_thr, "threshold_selection", 9, 4)
```

# Test-set performance

```{r predictions}
p_base  <- unname(predict(base_fit, newdata = sp$test_df, type = "response"))
p_ridge <- as.vector(predict(cv_ridge, x_test, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response"))
p_lasso <- as.vector(predict(cv_lasso, x_test, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response"))

metrics <- function(p, y, thr) {
  pred <- as.integer(p >= thr)
  tp <- sum(pred == 1 & y == 1); fn <- sum(pred == 0 & y == 1)
  fp <- sum(pred == 1 & y == 0); tn <- sum(pred == 0 & y == 0)
  data.frame(threshold = thr, TP = tp, FN = fn, FP = fp, TN = tn,
             recall = tp / (tp + fn), precision = tp / (tp + fp),
             specificity = tn / (tn + fp), accuracy = (tp + tn) / length(y),
             auc = as.numeric(auc(y, p, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)))
}

results <- rbind(
  cbind(model = "Logistic (baseline)", metrics(p_base,  y_test, 0.5)),
  cbind(model = "Ridge",               metrics(p_ridge, y_test, 0.5)),
  cbind(model = "Lasso",               metrics(p_lasso, y_test, 0.5)),
  cbind(model = "Ridge (recall thr.)", metrics(p_ridge, y_test, thr_ridge)),
  cbind(model = "Lasso (recall thr.)", metrics(p_lasso, y_test, thr_lasso))
)
write.csv(results, file.path(TAB_DIR, "classification_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(results, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Model", "Threshold", "TP", "FN", "FP", "TN", "Recall", "Precision",
                    "Specificity", "Accuracy", "AUC"),
      caption = "Test-set performance (malignant = positive class). FN = missed cancers.")
```

```{r fig-roc, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}
probs <- list("Logistic (baseline)" = p_base, "Ridge" = p_ridge, "Lasso" = p_lasso)
roc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(probs), function(m) {
  r <- roc(y_test, probs[[m]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
  data.frame(model = m, fpr = 1 - r$specificities, tpr = r$sensitivities)
}))
roc_df$model <- factor(roc_df$model, levels = names(probs))
auc_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (AUC = %.3f)", names(probs), results$auc[1:3]), names(probs))

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr, color = model)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = MODEL_COLS, labels = auc_lab, name = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Test-set ROC curves",
       x = "False positive rate (1 - specificity)", y = "True positive rate (recall)") +
  theme_report + guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
save_fig(p_roc, "roc_curves", 6, 6)
```

# Which features do the models rely on?

Because all features are standardized, coefficient magnitudes are comparable within a model: each is the
change in log-odds of malignancy for a one-SD increase in that feature, holding the others fixed.
Ridge shrinks all coefficients toward zero, so its values are smaller overall; compare rankings, not raw
sizes, across the two models.

```{r coefs}
write.csv(coef_tbl, file.path(TAB_DIR, "classification_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(lasso_sel, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("Feature", "Lasso coefficient"),
      caption = sprintf("Lasso keeps %d of 30 features", nrow(lasso_sel)))
```

```{r fig-coefficients, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
long <- data.frame(feature = rep(coef_tbl$feature, 2),
                   model   = factor(rep(c("Ridge", "Lasso"), each = nrow(coef_tbl)),
                                    levels = c("Ridge", "Lasso")),
                   coef    = c(coef_tbl$ridge, coef_tbl$lasso))
long$feature   <- factor(long$feature, levels = coef_tbl$feature[order(abs(coef_tbl$ridge))])
long$direction <- ifelse(long$coef > 0, "Raises malignancy odds",
                         ifelse(long$coef < 0, "Lowers malignancy odds", "Dropped (lasso = 0)"))
long$direction <- factor(long$direction,
                         levels = c("Raises malignancy odds", "Lowers malignancy odds", "Dropped (lasso = 0)"))

p_coef <- ggplot(long, aes(coef, feature)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = direction), width = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = subset(long, coef == 0), aes(shape = direction), color = "grey55", size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Raises malignancy odds" = "#b2182b",
                               "Lowers malignancy odds" = "#2166ac"),
                    breaks = c("Raises malignancy odds", "Lowers malignancy odds"),
                    na.value = "grey80", name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Dropped (lasso = 0)" = 4), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Standardized coefficients at lambda.1se",
       x = "Coefficient (change in log-odds per 1 SD)", y = NULL) +
  theme_report + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
save_fig(p_coef, "coefficients", 9, 8)
```

```{r export-top-features}
# Format required by compare_features.Rmd: feature, rank, importance (|coefficient|)
to_ranked <- function(feature, coef) {
  d <- data.frame(feature = feature, importance = round(abs(coef), 4))
  d <- d[order(-d$importance), ]
  d$rank <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  d[, c("feature", "rank", "importance")]
}
ridge_out <- to_ranked(coef_tbl$feature, coef_tbl$ridge)        # all 30, ranked by |coef|
lasso_out <- to_ranked(lasso_sel$feature, lasso_sel$lasso)      # only features lasso kept
write.csv(ridge_out, file.path(FEAT_DIR, "ridge_logistic.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lasso_out, file.path(FEAT_DIR, "lasso_logistic.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

top10_l <- head(lasso_out, 10)[match(1:10, head(lasso_out, 10)$rank), ]
kable(cbind(head(ridge_out, 10), top10_l), row.names = FALSE, digits = 3,
      col.names = c("Ridge feature", "Rank", "|coef|", "Lasso feature", "Rank", "|coef|"),
      caption = "Top 10 features submitted to the cross-method comparison")
```
